title: A Alibi for the Witness
author: Mara Crane
blurb: Ansel Sandoval, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
